violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed sliced Provolone cheese at 59F in 2 DWR prep cooler (50F) and commercial ranch dressing at 53F in 1 DR prep cooler (50F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC relocated sliced Provolone cheese and commercial ranch dressing, which had been stored in the coolers for no more than 4 hours, to walk-in cooler maintaining the proper temperature.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DWR prep cooler (back load) at 59F; 1 DR prep cooler (back load) at 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discontinued use of the 2 DWR prep cooler; 1 Dr prep cooler and contacted a technician during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Observed employee’s belongings stored among food- shampoo and conditioner bottles stored on the kitchen shelf.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. PIC moved employee’s belongings to a designated area.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PRECOOKED GRILLED CHICKEN AT 50-55F, FETA AT 53F, PROVOLONE AT 56F, AND CHEDDAR CHEESE AT 58F IN TWO-DRAWER PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND PUT IN A WORK ORDER FOR A CONTRACTOR TO LOOK AT THE BOTTOM DRAWER OF THE TWO-DRAWER PREP TOP.
